title: AR Aging Summary endpoint returns 403 for users without ROLE_ACCOUNT_RECEIVABLE_REPORT::VIEW
preconds: Build with CRP-BE-SEC deployed. Two test users: User A on system-tech (no AP/AR access), User B on system-owner (full access).
steps:
1. Log in as User A. Capture session token / cookie.
  2. Hit GET on the AR Aging Summary endpoint exposed by AgingSummaryController (see api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Controller/AgingSummaryController.php for the routed path).
  3. Inspect the HTTP response status and body.
  4. Log in as User B. Hit the same endpoint.
  5. Inspect status and body.
expected:
Step 3: User A receives HTTP 403 Forbidden with no AR aging data in the body.
Step 5: User B receives HTTP 200 with the AR aging data payload. If User A returns 200 with data, the security gap is still live — fail this case and escalate immediately.
